messages:
Ava (AE): GraniteBank wants a 6mo private pilot. asking 30% off list, waive onboarding, PO needed by Fri.
Ben (RevOps): what's list for their requested stack?
Ava (AE): private VPC, reserved 2xA100 equiv, premium support = $140k/mo. 30% -> $98k/mo.
Isha (Security): they also submitted a security addendum and want reduced audit retention. we need completed attestation before go-live.
Rex (Eng): reserved capacity lead time ~10 business days. can offer fast-start on shared infra and migrate.
Ava (AE): proposing two offers:
Option A: 25% off for 6mo pilot, onboarding fee waived, conversion window 45d, conversion credit = 50% of pilot invoices as dollar credit to first post-conversion invoice (cap $125k).
Option B: 20% off for 12mo commit, $25k onboarding credit, plus $15k/month compute-offset credits for pilot spikes.
Ben (RevOps): finance floor for unconstrained pilots = 22%. 25% requires deal-desk conditional approval: PO by Fri (3777777805), signed conversion intent during pilot, and security attestation within 10 days.
DealDeskBot: conditional approval ok with those conditions. note: if any condition fails discount void and billing reverts to standard prices.
Ava (AE): I'll send the term sheet with Legal wording and include compute-offset dollar equivalent. will update when PO arrives. :crossed_fingers:
